    .posture-panel {
      margin-top: 16px;
      border: 1px solid #1a1a2e;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #12121a;
      padding: 10px 12px;
    }
    .posture-title {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      color: #555570;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .posture-headline {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: baseline;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
    }
    .posture-name {
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #e0e0e8;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
    }
    .posture-source,
    .posture-counts,
    .posture-transition {
      color: #555570;
      font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
    }
    .posture-transition {
      margin-top: 6px;
    }
    .posture-failure {
      margin-top: 6px;
      color: #ff4444;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
    }
    .posture-diagnostic summary {
      color: #555570;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .posture-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: baseline;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 6px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid #1a1a2e;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
    }
    .posture-cap {
      font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      color: #e0e0e8;
      min-width: 190px;
    }
    .posture-desired,
    .posture-observed {
      font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      color: #555570;
    }
    .posture-reason {
      flex-basis: 100%;
      color: #555570;
    }
    .posture-empty {
      color: #555570;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
    }
    .posture-park {
      margin-top: 8px;
      border-top: 1px solid #1a1a2e;
      padding-top: 8px;
      color: #555570;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
    }
    .posture-park-headline {
      color: #e0e0e8;
      font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    }
    .posture-park-line {
      font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
